name: eSemnBun
subtitle: Sign with your electronic ID
shortDescription: Sign and verify documents with the Moldovan electronic identity card.
description:
Your electronic ID. Your documents. A straightforward signing workflow.

eSemnBun helps you sign PDFs and other files using the certificate on your Moldovan electronic identity card.

GET STARTED
1. Connect a compatible reader and insert your card.
2. Choose your card and add documents.
3. Approve the signing request and authorize PIN use.
4. Verify the result, then save or share your signed files.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Sign PDFs with PAdES and other files with XAdES.
• Prepare a batch of documents and authorize that batch once.
• Verify signatures and inspect certificate details.
• Use the built-in browser for card signing and login on compatible services.
• Open MSign, EVO, eVMS and MPay from service shortcuts.
• Choose Romanian, English or Russian and a light or dark appearance.
• Manage saved PINs and separately clear browser cache, cookies or history.

REQUIREMENTS
You need an active Moldovan electronic identity card, a valid signing certificate and a compatible card reader. Use an appropriate adapter for your device when needed. Internet access is needed for portals, timestamps and online certificate checks.

Your private key stays on the card. An incorrect PIN is never retried automatically. Demo mode lets you explore the interface without hardware; its outputs are not real signatures.

eSemnBun is an independent app. It does not represent the Government of Moldova or public-service operators. Portal availability and authentication methods are controlled by their providers.
releaseNotes: Clearer document actions and signing controls. Improved saved-document handling and PIN prompt behavior. Refreshed store screenshots.
promotionalText: Connect your reader, choose your documents and sign with your electronic ID. Verify the result and access compatible services in the built-in browser.

platformNotes.ios: For iPhone: NFC is available on supported models. On iPad, use a compatible external reader. Import documents from Files, drag-and-drop or the share extension. NFC signing uses one card presentation after PIN confirmation.
platformNotes.macos: The Mac App Store version uses CryptoTokenKit and App Sandbox. Export results to a chosen location. The external card-insertion helper, vendor-app process control and browser routes accepting arbitrary filesystem paths are not included.
platformNotes.android:
eSemnBun is an independent open-source app by Nicolae Ghimbovschi. It does not represent, and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorized by the Government of Moldova or any government entity. It is a document-signing tool, not a government service.

OFFICIAL SOURCES
Official sources for signing, authentication, public-service and payment information are linked below. External services are operated by their respective providers; eSemnBun does not issue identity cards or certificates and cannot decide eligibility or guarantee access. Check requirements and current information on the official sites.
MSign — https://msign.gov.md/
MPass — https://mpass.gov.md/
EVO — https://evo.gov.md/
eVMS — https://evms.md/
MPay — https://mpay.gov.md/

On NFC-capable phones or tablets, enable NFC and hold the card near the device’s antenna. Devices without NFC can use a compatible USB reader through OTG. Import, save and share with system controls.
platformNotes.windows: For Windows: connect a compatible reader and add documents by drag-and-drop, the file picker or the eSemnBun Explorer command. Command placement depends on the Windows version and installed package.

releaseNotesByPlatform.ios: Sign with a compatible Moldovan electronic identity card over NFC, or use a card reader. A simpler Sign screen guides you to the next step. Settings now brings cards, saved PINs and preferences together.
releaseNotesByPlatform.macos: Manage cards, readers, and saved PINs in Settings. Documents now offers direct access to file protection and deletion.
releaseNotesByPlatform.android: Sign with a compatible Moldovan electronic identity card over NFC, or use a card reader. A simpler Sign screen guides you to the next step. Settings now brings cards, saved PINs and preferences together.
releaseNotesByPlatform.windows: Manage cards, readers, and saved PINs in Settings. Options are grouped by category, and the tray window stays in place while open.
releaseNotesByPlatform.linux: Cards and readers now live in Settings alongside saved PINs and preferences. Sign uses a compact card selector and keeps document drag-and-drop available.

descriptionByPlatform.ios:
Your electronic ID. Your documents. A straightforward signing workflow.

GET STARTED
1. Choose a document or drop it onto Sign.
2. Choose NFC or a compatible card reader.
3. Continue, confirm your PIN, then hold the card near your phone until signing finishes. With a reader, leave the card inserted.
4. Verify, save or share the signed document.

Sign PDFs with PAdES and other files with XAdES. Verify signatures and view certificate details. Manage cards and saved PINs in Settings. The same card identity and saved PIN work with NFC and a reader. Choose Romanian, English or Russian and a light or dark appearance. Compatible portals are available in the built-in browser; NFC document signing does not imply NFC login support for every portal.

You need a supported Moldovan electronic identity card with an active signing certificate and its PIN. NFC signing requires a compatible contactless card and an NFC-capable device. Card generations and devices can differ; a compatible external reader remains available. Internet access is needed for timestamps, online certificate checks and portals.

The private key stays on your card. An incorrect PIN is never retried automatically. Demo mode uses fictional data and does not create real signatures.

eSemnBun is an independent app and does not represent the Government of Moldova or public-service operators.
